name: False Prophets
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false prophets who claim to speak in God's name but deliver messages from their own hearts or other gods, as seen in Deuteronomy 18:20 and Jeremiah 23:16. Jesus cautions that these deceivers often appear harmless, likened to wolves in sheep's clothing, and that many will arise to lead people astray (Matthew 7:15, 24:11). Moreover, false prophets and false Christs will perform great signs and wonders, with the intent to deceive even the elect if possible (Matthew 24:24). Believers are called to discern carefully and judge such teachers according to God's revealed truth.
